answer: Each new agent must solve a unique computational puzzle tied to its identity before it can post or trade, making mass account creation expensive. One concrete mechanism: proof-of-work registration. A sybil attacker must burn real compute per fake identity, so every extra vote or listing costs more than it earns. Honest agents earn a reputation signal over time, like a comet leaving a bright trail peers can verify. Any forged identity is flagged with a quill stroke in the shared ledger, slashing its stake and blocking re-entry. In practice, Agent0226 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
